exams.notes: Written or oral, or both, upon subjects relating to the science of dentistry; may also include demonstration of skill in operative and prosthetic dentistry

exams.notes: Referenced for dental residents/resident permit holders
exams.quote: is a graduate of a dental school approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation and has passed Part I and Part II of the National Board Dental examination

interval_years.quote: all professional or occupational licenses or certificates of registration... shall, on and after the effective date of this act, be issued for periods of two years and be biennially renewable

required.quote: The New Jersey State Board of Dentistry shall require each person licensed as a dentist, as a condition for biennial registration pursuant to R.S.45:6-10 and P.L.1972, c.108 (C.45:1-7), to complete a requisite number of credits of continuing dental education

period_years.quote: as a condition for biennial registration

value: one credit of educational programs or topics concerning prescription opioid drugs, including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion
topical_requirements.quote: include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning prescription opioid drugs, including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion

available.quote: The board may, in its discretion, without such examination, issue its license to practice dentistry to any applicant therefor who desires to remove to this state from another state of the United States or from a foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed and practiced dentistry for at least five years immediately preceding the application; must present proof by affidavit; must present a certificate from the board of dental examiners of the prior state certifying competency and good moral character; certificate must be presented not more than six months after its date of issue; and the issuing state must recognize certificates from NJ in like manner.
requirements.quote: issue its license to practice dentistry to any applicant therefor who desires to remove to this state from another state of the United States or from a foreign country, in which he was licensed to practice dentistry and has conducted the practice of dentistry for at least five years immediately preceding the application to the board for such license, if such applicant presents proof, by affidavit or otherwise, of the facts above mentioned, and presents a certificate from the board of dental examiners or from the board or official exercising similar powers of the state or county from which he desires to remove, certifying that he is a competent dentist or dental surgeon, and of good moral character

title_protection.quote: Uses a dental degree, or the terms "mechanical dentist" or the use of the word "dentist" in English or any foreign language, or designation, or card, device, directory, poster, sign, or other media whereby he represents himself as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice dentistry within the meaning of this chapter unless licensed so to do

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in professional or occupational misconduct as determined by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or engaged in acts constituting any crime or offense with a direct or substantial relationship to the regulated activity or inconsistent with public health, safety, or welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board or is of a nature such that certification, registration or licensure of the person would be inconsistent with the public's health, safety, or welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having authority to engage in the regulated activity revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or failing to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging licensee functions in a manner consistent with public health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the insurance fraud prevention law or being adjudicated of such violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of P.L.1983, c.320 (C.17:33A-1 et seq.) or any insurance fraud prevention law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where the applicant or holder knew or should have known that the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license is required, or aiding and abetting unlicensed practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No industrial or corporate dental clinic shall be established, operated, conducted or maintained in this State unless and until a permit to do so has first been obtained from the State Board of Registration and Examination in Dentistry

definition_quote.value: Any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter who uses a dental degree, or the terms 'mechanical dentist' or the use of the word 'dentist'... or who performs dental operations of any kind gratuitously, or for a fee, gift, compensation or reward...
definition_quote.quote: Any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter who

value: diagnose, treat, prescribe or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, cheek, or jaws, or oral cavity and associated tissues
perform dental operations of any kind
use Roentgen or X-ray machine for dental treatment, dental radiograms, or dental diagnostic purposes
extract a human tooth or teeth, or correct or attempt to correct malpositions of the human teeth or jaws
diagnose, treat or remove stains or concretions from human teeth or jaws
use or administer local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases
take impressions of the human tooth, teeth, jaws, or perform any phase of any operation incident to the replacement of a part of a tooth, teeth, or associated tissues
methods_authorized.quote: Extracts a human tooth or teeth, or corrects or attempts to correct malpositions of the human teeth or jaws; or Offers and undertakes, by any means or method, to diagnose, treat or remove stains or concretions from human teeth or jaws; or Uses or administers local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe medication and treatment for patients admitted for dental or oral and maxillofacial surgical problems, and may prescribe or administer controlled dangerous substances in the course of professional practice.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribe medication and treatment for patients admitted for dental or oral and maxillofacial surgical problems.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means acts performed in the office of a licensed dentist wherein he is physically present at all times during the performance of such acts... "Supervision" means acts performed pursuant to a dentist's written order, control and full professional responsibility, whether or not he is physically present.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed as permitting a licensed dental hygienist to establish an independent office or engage in independent practice in connection with the performance of traditional hygienist services whether or not there is supervision or direct supervision of a licensed dentist.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: Each licensed dentist may provide supervision to no more than three licensed dental hygienists at one time.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed as permitting a licensed dental hygienist to establish an independent office or engage in independent practice in connection with the performance of traditional hygienist services whether or not there is supervision or direct supervision of a licensed dentist.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall practice or continue to practice, offer or undertake to practice, or hold itself out as practicing dentistry. No person shall practice or continue to practice dentistry as an officer, agent or employee of any corporation

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A practitioner shall register to access prescription monitoring information upon initial application for, or renewal of, the practitioner's CDS registration.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: the making of artificial restorations, substitutes, or appliances for the correction of disease, loss, deformity, malposition, dislocation, fracture, or injury to the jaws, teeth, lips, gums, cheeks, palate, or cases, models, or from impressions furnished by a licensed and registered dentist, on written prescription only

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist licensed by this State shall be marked with the name and social security number of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended unless the patient objects thereto.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The administration of local anesthesia, the monitoring of a patient administered nitrous oxide, and any other anesthetic procedures that may be designated by the New Jersey State Board of Dentistry, by regulation, shall be performed by a licensed dental hygienist only under direct supervision.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: the monitoring of a patient administered nitrous oxide, and any other anesthetic procedures that may be designated by the New Jersey State Board of Dentistry, by regulation, shall be performed by a licensed dental hygienist only under direct supervision.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Any person who has graduated from a school or college of dental hygiene approved by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association and has been licensed to practice dental hygiene in this State and holds a current certification in Basic or Advanced Cardiac Life Support by an association approved by the board

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed as permitting a licensed dental hygienist to establish an independent office or engage in independent practice in connection with the performance of traditional hygienist services whether or not there is supervision or direct supervision of a licensed dentist.
